name: Begin with You! - The Story of Precious Days
source:
Main character is a ronin in pursuit of the university of his dream. But preparatory days pass without excitement as he wants to have a serious life with classmates already. Everything begins with one fateful encounter. Everything begins with you.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名复读生，正努力考取梦想中的大学。但枯燥的补习生活毫无乐趣，他已经渴望尽快与同学们一同过上真正的生活。一切始于一场命中注定的邂逅，一切从你开始。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
